notes.title: Full game release - Version 1.0 changelog
notes.content:
[h1]Full Game version of the game has been released![/h1] 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1144550/Bride_for_the_Princess/

[h2]We also have released Digital Artbook[/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1429860/Bride_for_the_Princess__Digital_Artbook/?curator_clanid=37792130

You may also get them together on a Special Edition.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/16263/

[h3]Changelog[/h3]

[b]Achievement [/b]

[list][*]New Achievement "Commence the Clowning", marry Clarimond
[*]New Achievement "One for each day of the week", have six concubines and a wife[/list]

[b]Bugfix[/b]

[list][*]Asking Etsuko to come to the ruins on the second day caused her texture to change to Tephna's, this has been fixed
[*]Tephna had wrong marriage pictures during her wedding, this has been changed
[*]You could ask Ryia to marry you, even when you were already promised to another marriage, this has been fixed
[*]You could ask Annabelle to marry you, even when you were already promised to another marriage, this has been fixed
[*]You could ask Etsuko to marry you, even when you were already promised to another marriage, this has been fixed
[*]Running away with Etsuko during the riot would always have the player called "Mary" during one sentence; regardless of the name actually used, this has been fixed
[*]Wanting to marry Demoness without feeding Annabelle to her, would cause the trigger to marry her not to appear; this has been fixed
[*]Fixed backlog messages corruption when exceeding message capacity
[*]Fixed backlog messages appear in incorrect order when loading a saved game
[*]Fixed save-load UI using wrong slot prototype for quick load grid
[*]Fixed auto and skip modes retain after showing UIs, which block user input (backlog, save-load, settings, etc.)[/list]

[b]CG[/b]

[list][*]Golden Idol's picture is added to the CG gallery upon finding it[/list]

[b]Gameplay[/b]

[list][*]Added new dateable character Clarimond, the Battle Clown.
[*]You can now have a harem by asking women to become your concubines, instead of just proposing to them.
[*]Removed ability to call aid from Tephna, which didn't actually do anything
[*]Ryia has a flavor text in the ending if you put her in jail or kept her around[/list]

[b]Grammar[/b]

[list][*]"How's thaT?" changed to "How's that?"
[*]"I woudln't" changed to "I wouldn't"
[*]"emotieneless" changed to "emotionless"
[*]"Ask details" changed to "Ask for details"
[*]"propper" changed to "proper"[/list]

[b]Graphics[/b]

[list][*]All the sex scenes have been redrawn from scratch
[*]Marrying Ryia has a kissing picture at the wedding like other marriages[/list]

[b]Localization[/b]

[list][*]Added localization in Chinese[/list]

[b]Marriage[/b]

[list][*]We now see the chapel, while the priest talks. When invited; the couple comes forward to view for the ceremony and exchanging the vows[/list]

[b]Lore[/b] 

[list][*]New Lore Entry "Origin of Battle Clowns"[/list]

[b]UI[/b]

[list][*]Removed the Early Access bug reporting tool[/list]

Unity Version

[list][*]Updated to 2019.4.13f1[/list]

notes.title: Coming in the full version
